sources.title: ruMeme Descriptions
sources.author: foldl
sources.retrieval_method: Hugging Face datasets-server rows API; active images stored locally without content modification
sources.selection_rule: Each active image was visually assigned its readable text language. Images with no readable text use the und label; images with watermarks or animated-media characters are removed and retained only in the historical ledger.

sources.title: Other static meme sources
sources.selection_rule: Source links are preserved in each meme card. Only static images are active; the same visual review, duplicate history, watermark, and animated-character rules apply.
